title: Parallel CI prerequisites
summary: Full CI runs repo checks and timing refresh in reuse-coverage, parallel with collection and wheel construction in repo-contracts. Shared file assignment uses committed weights; the refreshed artifact orders files within shards. Both prerequisite jobs must pass, and required check names remain unchanged. Docker Postgres start allows 120 seconds per attempt, removes the named container once after a failed attempt, then retries once. Final failure logs bounded container status, the last 50 log lines and Docker info before the existing command-failure refusal; tests never start on setup failure.
